sn5.6:1.2: Atha kho Cālā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā || pa ||
sn5.6:1.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Cālā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Cālaṃ bhikkhunim etad avoca || ||
sn5.6:1.5: Kiṃ nu tvaṃ bhikkhuni na rocesīti || ||
sn5.6:2.1: Kiṃ nu tvaṃ jātiṃ na rocesi || ||
sn5.6:6.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || jānāti maṃ Cālā bhikkhunīti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ || || 2.
